run_doctest_long: run the doctest suite for the Boost.Python long integer test module
test_new_long: test the new_long C++ extension function that creates a new long integer with value 0
test_longify: test the longify C++ extension function that converts an integer to a long value
test_is_long: test the is_long C++ extension function that checks if an argument is a long type
test_longify_string: test the longify_string C++ extension function that converts a string to a long value
